Definition: from G1537 and the base of G32; to publish, i.e. celebrate:--shew forth.
BiblicalUsage: In the New Testament, exangéllō is the word for shew forth. In 1 Peter 2:9, the text says "that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, exangéllō means shew forth, nothing more and nothing less.
